MINUTES
  MALIBU CITY COUNCIL
  SPECIAL MEETING
  SEPTEMBER 25, 2025
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  10:00 A.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Riggins called the meeting to order at 10:12 a.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Mayor Marianne Riggins; Mayor Pro Tern Bruce Silverstein; and
  Councilmembers Haylynn Conrad, Doug Stewart and Steve Uhring.

  ALSO PRESENT: Trevor Rusin, Interim City Attorney; Candace Bond, Interim City
  Manager; Yolanda Bundy, Community Development Director; Parker Davis, Media
  Technician; Christina Mufioz, Deputy City Clerk; Jason Lawrence, Deputy City Clerk;
  Tyler Eaton, Principal Planner; Gail Duncan, Administrative Assistant.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Mayor Riggins led the Pledge of Allegiance.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  Deputy City Clerk Munoz reported that the agenda for the meeting was properly posted on
  September 12, 2025, with the amended agenda posted on September 24, 2025.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Mayor Pro Tern Silverstein moved, and Councilmember Uhring seconded a motion
  to approve the agenda. The motion carried unanimously.

ITEM 1  ORDINANCES AND PUBLIC HEARINGS

  A.  Appeals of Planning Commission Resolution No. 24-013 Regarding Coastal
  Development Permit No. 22-040 — An application to restore a wetland buffer that
  was disturbed due to unpermitted weed abatement (23855 Civic Center Way,
  Owner, Civic Center Way LLC; Appellants, Malibu Township Council and Malibu
  Coalition for Slow Growth jointly, and Civic Center Way LLC)

  Recommended Action: Consider Resolution No. 25-40 and Appeal Nos. 24-002
  and 24-003, determine if the project is categorically exempt from the California
  Environmental Quality Act (CEQA), and direct staff to return with a resolution
  matching the Council's decision regarding Coastal Development Permit (CDP) No.
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of September 25, 2025
  Page 2 of 3

  22-040 to restore a wetland Environmentally Sensitive Habitat Area (ESHA) buffer
  that was disturbed due to unpermitted weed abatement in the Community
  Commercial (CC) zoning district located at 23855 Civic Center Way (Civic Center
  Way LLC).

CONSENSUS
  By consensus, the Council determined that the applicant and each appellant would
  be given 20 minutes for their presentation, including rebuttal.

  Disclosures: Councilmembers Conrad, Uhring, Stewart, Mayor Pro Tern
  Silverstein and Mayor Riggins.

  Principal Planner Eaton presented the staff report.

  The Council directed questions to staff.

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor to public comment.

  Speakers: Patt Healy, Jo Drummond, Victor de la Cruz, Leticia Aloi, Scott Dittrich
  (Bill Sampson deferred time to Scott Dittirch), Jan Skophamer, Colin Drummond,
  Ryan Embree.

  Patt Healy, Jo Drummond, and Victor de la Cruz provided rebuttal to public
  comment.

  As there were no other speakers present, Mayor Riggins closed the public hearing
  and returned the matter to the table for discussion.

RECESS  At 12:32 p.m., Mayor Riggins recessed the meeting. The meeting resumed at 12:47
  p.m. with all Councilmembers present.

  At 1:45 p.m., Victor de la Cruz was recognized by the Mayor and stated Civic
  Center Way LLC was withdrawing the application.

  As there was not an application to consider, the matter was concluded.

RECESS  At 1:49 p.m., Mayor Riggins recessed the meeting. The meeting resumed at 1:55
  p.m. with all Councilmembers present.

ITEM 2  OLD BUSINESS

  A.  Rebuild Policies to Facilitate the Rebuilding of Structures Damaged or Destroyed
  by Natural Disasters

  Recommended Action: Approve Rebuild Policies; LCP and Zoning Code
  Interpretation (LCP Interpretation Number 24 and Zoning Code Interpretation
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of September 25, 2025
  Page 3 of 3

  Number 15) to facilitate the rebuild of structures destroyed by natural disasters.

  Principal Planner Eaton presented the staff report.

  The Council directed questions to staff.

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor to public comment.

  Speakers: Marissa Coughlan, Luis Tefia, Llyod Ahern, Joanne, Luca Iacovoni,
  Ryan Embree, Danny Smith, Jo Drummond, Andrew Sheldon, Darren Graves

  As there were no other speakers present, Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the
  table for discussion.

  The Council discussed the item.

MOTION  Mayor Pro-Tem Silverstein moved, and Councilmember Stewart seconded a
  motion to approve the policy document with modifications to PF1 deleting the text
  "it may be denied if the city cannot make the required findings listed in the MMC"
  to state "such approval must still be obtained", and to return at the next regular
  meeting with PF4 while PF10 will be determined at a later date. The question was
  called, and the motion carried 4-1, Councilmember Conrad opposed.

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Riggins adjourned the meeting at 3:07 p.m.

  Approved and adopted by the City Council of the
  City of Malibu on May 26, 2026.

  BRUCE SILVERSTEIN, Mayor
